harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-segment topology (lan-a: node3↔node1, transit: node1↔node2, lan-b: node2↔node4) on top of the extra NICs each node already had, discovered adjacency via ARP/ping probing (default mgmt NICs are all flat on 10.100.120.0/24 and unrelated to the data path). Configured VyOS (node1) with a source-NAT masquerade rule on its transit interface (eth1) for lan-a traffic, and OPNsense (node2) with a hybrid-mode outbound NAT masquerade rule on its lan-b interface (vtnet2) for transit-sourced traffic, plus matching pass rules on both opt interfaces. node4 runs a persistent (systemd) Python HTTP server on 8080. Verified with tcpdump on node1's transit link (source rewritten to node1's transit IP 10.50.20.1) and node2's lan-b link (source rewritten again to node2's lan-b IP 10.50.30.254), and node4's HTTP access log records the connection as arriving purely from 10.50.30.254 — never node3's or node1's real address. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes (node3, node1, node4, node2), confirming boot-identity change (boot_id / kern.boottime) on each and re-verifying full end-to-end connectivity and correct double-NAT source (10.50.30.254) after every restart.
actions_performed: Mapped the 4-node topology and discovered lan-a/transit/lan-b NIC adjacency via ARP/tcpdump probing

Assigned static addressing: node3 enp8s0=10.50.10.3/24 (gw node1), node1 eth2=10.50.10.254/24 (lan-a), node1 eth1=10.50.20.1/24 (transit), node2 vtnet1=10.50.20.2/24 (transit), node2 vtnet2=10.50.30.254/24 (lan-b), node4 enp8s0=10.50.30.4/24
Added node3 static route to 10.50.30.0/24 via node1, and node1 static route to 10.50.30.0/24 via node2's transit IP
Configured VyOS NAT source masquerade rule on node1 eth1 for source 10.50.10.0/24

Configured OPNsense (node2) config.xml: opt1/opt2 interface assignment, firewall pass rules on opt1/opt2, hybrid-mode outbound NAT masquerade rule on opt2 for source network opt1, applied via configctl filter reload / interface reconfigure
Opened firewalld port 8080/tcp on node4 and set up a persistent systemd service (demo-http.service) serving HTTP on 8080
Verified double-SNAT via tcpdump captures on node1 transit interface and node2 lan-b interface, and via node4's HTTP access log showing source 10.50.30.254

Executed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on node3, node1, node4, and node2: captured pre-restart boot identity, triggered native reboot with async-returning ack, polled until exec was available again, confirmed changed boot identity, and re-verified config persistence and full end-to-end connectivity/correct NAT source after each restart

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline: topology addressing, routes, NAT rules, and working end-to-end HTTP connection before any restarts
evidence.summary: Static addressing, routes, VyOS SNAT rule, OPNsense pass/NAT rules, and node4's persistent HTTP service were all put in place and confirmed working with a successful curl from node3 to node4:8080 before any restarts.

evidence.requirement: Double source-NAT: node1 translates on entering transit, node2 translates on entering lan-b, node4 records the connection as arriving from node2
evidence.summary: tcpdump on node1's transit interface (eth1) shows source rewritten from node3's real 10.50.10.3 to node1's transit IP 10.50.20.1; tcpdump on node2's lan-b interface (vtnet2) shows source rewritten again to node2's lan-b IP 10.50.30.254; node4's HTTP log records the client as 10.50.30.254 (node2), never node3 or node1.

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered config/connectivity
evidence.summary: boot_id captured pre-restart (9d3cb897...), reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect, boot_id changed post-restart to 24e2fbeb..., interfaces/route/NAT rule persisted, and node3→node4 curl succeeded again through node1.

evidence.requirement: node2 (OPNsense) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered config/connectivity
evidence.summary: kern.boottime captured pre-restart (05:55:14), reboot acknowledged before disconnect (subsequent poll timed out), kern.boottime changed post-restart to 06:07:27, vtnet1/vtnet2 addressing, filter pass rules, and outbound NAT rule all persisted, and the full HTTP flow re-succeeded with node4 logging source 10.50.30.254.

evidence.requirement: node3 (RHEL, lan-a client) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered config/connectivity
evidence.summary: boot_id captured pre-restart (4999270d...), systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect, boot_id changed post-restart to 3b0316b0..., static IP/route persisted via NetworkManager profile, and curl to node4:8080 succeeded again.

evidence.requirement: node4 (RHEL, lan-b HTTP server) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered service/data/connectivity
evidence.summary: boot_id captured pre-restart (bef0e5ec...), systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect, boot_id changed post-restart to fe34cea3..., demo-http.service came back active via systemd enablement, and node3's curl to it succeeded again post-restart.
